datasets.name: Bijie landslide dataset
datasets.verbatim: The experimental validation of the BASPP-SSCM technique is validated on a bijie landslide dataset [38]. The dataset covers 2773 samples under two classes... The data supporting this study’s findings are openly available in the Kaggle repository at https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/hanstankman/bijie-landslidedataset, reference number [38].

methods.name: Bidirectional Atrous Spatial Pyramid Pooling-Based Semantic Segmentation and Classification Model (BASPP-SSCM)
methods.summary: The BASPP-SSCM model is a multi-stage framework for landslide detection. It uses adaptive Wiener filtering for noise reduction, DeepLabV3 with a ConvNeXtLarge backbone for semantic segmentation, a CapsNet model for feature extraction, and a Ridgelet neural network (RNN) for classification, with parameters fine-tuned by the pelican optimization algorithm (POA).
methods.verbatim: This study develops a Bidirectional Atrous Spatial Pyramid Pooling-Based Semantic Segmentation and Classification Model (BASPP-SSCM) technique for landslide Remote Sensing Images.

availability.author_statement: Data availability statement present with shared links.

reproducibility_assessment: The Bijie landslide dataset is referenced and linked in a public repository. However, the custom BASPP-SSCM model code is not mentioned or provided.
